title: Scooter rider charged in hit-and-run crash with 12-year-old in Cambridge
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Local News The Beverly man pleaded not guilty to all charges.
A scooter rider is now charged in a July hit-and-run crash in Cambridge that seriously injured a 12-year-old.

Jayson Wilson, of Beverly, pleaded not guilty to charges of assault and battery with a deadly weapon resulting in serious bodily injury, leaving the scene of personal injury, reckless operation of a motor vehicle, and negligent operation of a motor vehicle in Cambridge District Court Monday, court documents show.
